description: This file defines the interface for managing lists of various entities in a Wi-Fi mesh network, including networks, devices, radios, BSS, stations, SSIDs, operation classes, policies, and scan results. It provides methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and iterating over these entities, encapsulating complex data management for the EasyMesh system.

classes.name: dm_easy_mesh_list_t
classes.description: A class that manages collections of Wi-Fi mesh network entities, providing methods for list management such as adding, removing, and retrieving networks, devices, radios, BSS, stations, SSIDs, operation classes, policies, and scan results.

methods.name: get_data_model
methods.description: Retrieves the data model associated with specified network ID and AL MAC address.

methods.name: create_data_model
methods.description: Creates a new data model for a given network and interface, with optional colocated flag.

methods.name: delete_data_model
methods.description: Deletes a data model identified by network ID and AL MAC address.

methods.name: delete_all_data_models
methods.description: Deletes all data models from the system.

methods.name: debug_probe
methods.description: Triggers debugging of the probe functionality.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Easy Mesh manager.

methods.name: dm_easy_mesh_t * get_first_dm()
methods.description: Retrieves the first dm_easy_mesh_t object in the list.

methods.name: dm_easy_mesh_t * get_next_dm(dm_easy_mesh_t * dm)
methods.description: Retrieves the next dm_easy_mesh_t object in the list after the given dm.

methods.name: get_first_network
methods.description: Returns the first network in the list.

methods.name: get_next_network
methods.description: Returns the next network after a given network.

methods.name: get_network
methods.description: Finds a network by given key.

methods.name: remove_network
methods.description: Removes a network identified by key.

methods.name: put_network
methods.description: Adds a network to the list with a specific key.

methods.name: get_first_device
methods.description: Returns the first device in the device list.

methods.name: get_next_device
methods.description: Returns the next device in the device list after the given device.

methods.name: get_device
methods.description: Finds a device by key.

methods.name: remove_device

methods.name: put_device
methods.description: Adds a device to the list with a specific key.

methods.name: get_first_radio

methods.name: get_next_radio

methods.name: get_radio

methods.name: remove_radio
methods.description: Removes a radio entry by key.

methods.name: put_radio
methods.description: Stores a radio configuration with an associated key.

methods.name: get_first_radio (network context)
methods.description: Returns the first radio matching network ID and AL MAC.

methods.name: get_next_radio (network context)
